correctness.rationale: The bound 1+3(n-3) is immediate; the periodic six-context witness attains it for all lengths. Every nonidentity cyclic rotation changes at least two positions, so the new terminal four-window can collide only with outputs of its two predecessors; six-letter locality follows. Direct generation of all 243 five-letter inputs gives 126 maximizers and the complete 21-state quotient; all 41 edges are rebuilt rather than assumed. The exact integer determinant and row-vector polynomial-annihilator checks prove the generating function for every length. Strong connectivity and a self-loop justify primitive Perron–Frobenius asymptotics. Direct brute-force outputs through n=9 and an independent periodic witness check support, but do not replace, the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The four-position cyclic shift models fixed-window synchronization ambiguity and is a directly motivated channel in recent coding research. Determining the entire infinite family of ternary worst-case input sequences, their exact count at every length, rational generating function, and asymptotic entropy resolves a natural structural gap beyond either a sphere maximum or a few small examples. The structural constraints matter because three symbols force repetitions inside every four-window. No downstream coding-rate gain is asserted.
